mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% over three months indicates a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased corporate costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between UNRATE decreases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over three months signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between HOUST increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over two months signals increased supply-side activity, which can lead to increased corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1%) for more than 6 months signals an accommodative monetary policy, which encourages investment in equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the FEDFUNDS rate is below 1%, or if the correlation between low FEDFUNDS and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% over the same period, it signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% MoM and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% MoM
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of RSAFS and UNRATE on returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 over a month and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) remains stable (increase < 0.1%), it signals strong labor demand without significant inflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 MoM and CPIAUCSL increases < 0.1% MoM
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of PAYEMS and CPIAUCSL on returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter signals a robust economic expansion, which leads to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between GDPC1 increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
